approximations: Future disciplinary ties use a seeded random decision before club coefficients.
Extra-time rates are one third of 90-minute rates; shootouts are 50/50.
Final venue is neutral; aggregate-score tactical changes are not modeled.
Future draws sample only permitted UEFA slots; official fixtures fix published pairings and venues.
Probabilities condition on fitted strengths; Monte Carlo errors exclude model uncertainty.

data.availability: Date-only domestic/supplement results and xG available next UTC day; timed API/PFL results after kickoff plus three hours.
data.relocated_venue_model: Verified relocated Shakhtar, Dynamo Kyiv and Maccabi Tel-Aviv European home fixtures, plus Besiktas–Maccabi in Debrecen on 2024-11-28, use neutral rates; home-support effects are not estimated.
data.domestic_reconciliation: Slovak, Ukrainian and Azerbaijani official tables checked against parsed played and goal totals; discrepancies reported per source. Czech pinned schedules have incomplete 2025/26 coverage.

strengths.uncertainty: Conditional fitted strengths; sparse or disconnected country offsets are regularized priors, not precise estimates.

uncertainty: Probabilities condition on fitted strengths; Monte Carlo errors exclude model, data and squad uncertainty.

prior_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity to league-offset shrinkage, including Monte Carlo noise; not a confidence interval.
